items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of an aerated grit chamber, a selector, a Dimminutor...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... an oxidation ditch, a secondary clarifier...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... a secondary clarifier, traveling bridge filters...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... traveling bridge filters...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... chlorine (Cl2) gas chlorination, and sulfur dioxide (SO2) gas dechlorination systems.
During the summer months, all treated wastewater is discharged to the Facility's five percolation ponds.
Biosolids produced in the aerobic digester are discharged to two gunite-lined sludge lagoons for storage and further decomposition.
During the summer months, three sludge drying beds are used to dry biosolids pumped from the sludge lagoons.
Dried biosolids are transported to a paved, upper area, located northeast of the Facility for further drying before being hauled to an offsite landfill.
